description: Search experimental (PDB) and predicted (computed-model) protein structures by free text, protein sequence (triggers an mmseqs2 similarity search), and/or organism, method, resolution, and bound-ligand filters. Returns ranked hits; the experimental page is enriched with title, method, resolution, and source organisms (for a sequence hit, those of the matched entity), and every sequence hit carries its identity, E-value, bit score, and aligned range against the query. Chain hit IDs into protein_get_structure. Optionally returns a facet breakdown (counts by method / organism / release year / …) alongside the hits in the same response. Facets count the filtered result set, so an active organism or method filter also constrains its own facet: the facet lists only the values found in the matching entries (other organisms in the same complexes, other methods deposited with the same entries), never the alternatives the filter excluded. Numeric histogram buckets (resolution, molecular weight) carry explicit rangeFrom/rangeTo bounds so a boundary label is unambiguous.

content_type.description: Which structure universe to search: experimental (PDB), predicted (computed models), or all.

facets.description: Optional dimensions to summarize as a facet breakdown alongside the hits. Each dimension at most once; repeating one is rejected.

ligand.description: Filter by bound ligand: an exact chemical component ID (e.g. "STI" for imatinib, "HEM"), in any letter case. Keeps structures holding the component as a bound (non-polymer) copy, not as a residue inside a polymer chain. Resolve a ligand name to its ID with protein_track_ligands mode "find_ligand". Computed models carry no ligands, so under content_type "predicted" this filter matches nothing.

max_evalue.description: Maximum E-value for a sequence search. Requires sequence — supplying it without one is rejected, since the threshold filters only a sequence search. Default 1.

max_resolution.description: Maximum resolution in Å (lower is sharper); applies to experimental structures.

method.description: Filter by experimental method: X-RAY DIFFRACTION, ELECTRON MICROSCOPY, SOLUTION NMR, SOLID-STATE NMR, ELECTRON CRYSTALLOGRAPHY, NEUTRON DIFFRACTION, FIBER DIFFRACTION, POWDER DIFFRACTION, SOLUTION SCATTERING, EPR, FLUORESCENCE TRANSFER, INFRARED SPECTROSCOPY, THEORETICAL MODEL (any letter case), or an alias: cryo-EM / cryoEM / EM → ELECTRON MICROSCOPY; X-ray / xray → X-RAY DIFFRACTION; NMR → SOLUTION NMR + SOLID-STATE NMR. Any other value is rejected. Computed models carry no method, so under content_type "predicted" this filter matches nothing.

min_identity.description: Minimum sequence identity (0–1) for a sequence search. Requires sequence — supplying it without one is rejected, since the threshold filters only a sequence search. Default 0.

organism.description: Filter by source organism: a scientific name ("Homo sapiens"), an NCBI common name ("human", "E. coli"), or an NCBI taxon ID ("9606"), in any letter case. Matches that taxon and every taxon under it (strains, subspecies); a multi-word name also matches scientific names that contain it, such as "Escherichia coli (strain K12)". A word fragment ("coli") matches nothing.

query.description: Free-text query (protein name, gene, keyword, PDB title terms).

sequence.description: Protein sequence for RCSB mmseqs2: at least 10 residues in A–I or K–Z (J excluded; B/O/U/X/Z accepted). Whitespace is removed and ASCII lowercase normalized.

start.description: Zero-based result offset. Combine with limit to retrieve later pages.

name: protein_search_structures

effectiveQuery.description: Echoed text query for follow-up calls.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_sequence`: The RCSB protein sequence contains invalid residues or has fewer than 10 residues after whitespace removal. `no_criteria`: No query, sequence, organism, method, maximum resolution, or ligand was provided — nothing to search on. `unknown_method`: method is neither one of the 13 RCSB experimental methods nor an accepted alias, so it could only ever match nothing. `sequence_modifier_without_sequence`: min_identity or max_evalue was supplied with no sequence, so the threshold would never reach a sequence search. `duplicate_dimension`: facets lists the same dimension twice, which would return that breakdown twice. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Optional facet breakdown when requested — one flat dimension per requested facet. Cross-tabs (a dimension nested inside another) are protein_analyze_collection territory.

items.description: A facet dimension and its aggregation buckets.
A leaf aggregation bucket: a value and its entry count.

count.description: Number of entries in the bucket.

label.description: Bucket value — category, numeric bin start, or period.

rangeFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound of a numeric histogram bin (= label). Present only for numeric facets (resolution, molecular_weight); absent for term/period facets.

rangeTo.description: Exclusive upper bound of a numeric histogram bin (rangeFrom + bin interval), so the bin covers [rangeFrom, rangeTo). Present only for numeric facets.

dimension.description: Friendly dimension name (e.g. method, organism, release_year).

missingValueCount.description: Matches in scope that carry no value for this attribute, so they count toward the response total but fall in no bucket (e.g. computed models have no experimental method; solution-NMR entries have no diffraction resolution). Independent of truncation — measured before the bucket cap is applied. 0 means no shortfall was detectable: a multi-valued attribute such as organism can place one match in several buckets, which offsets the shortfall rather than adding to it.

truncated.description: True when buckets were capped by the per-dimension bucket limit.

items.description: A ranked structure hit with optional enrichment metadata.

alignmentLength.description: Alignment length in columns, gaps included (sequence hits).

entityId.description: Matched polymer-entity ID for sequence hits (e.g. 4HHB_1, AF_AFP69905F1_1); id remains the chainable entry ID.

id.description: Structure identifier (PDB entry ID or computed-model ID).

identity.description: Sequence identity 0–1 over the alignment, to 4 decimal places (sequence hits).

organisms.description: Source organisms (enriched experimental hits): for a sequence hit, those of the matched entity (entityId); otherwise every distinct source organism of the entry, in entity-number order. Omitted when unknown, including a sequence hit whose matched entity the entry's metadata lacks.

queryEnd.description: Last aligned residue of the query, 1-based, inclusive (sequence hits).

queryStart.description: First aligned residue of the query, 1-based, inclusive (sequence hits).

score.description: RCSB relevance score, relative to the other hits of this search rather than a similarity measure; a sequence hit's similarity is in identity, evalue, and bitscore.

source.description: Which universe the hit came from.

targetEnd.description: Last aligned residue of the hit, 1-based, inclusive, in the same entity sequence as targetStart (sequence hits).

targetLength.description: Length in residues of the entity sequence that targetStart and targetEnd index into (sequence hits).

targetStart.description: First aligned residue of the hit, 1-based, inclusive, in the matched entity's sequence — not author residue numbering (sequence hits).

uniprotAccession.description: UniProt accession parsed from a computed-model ID, when available.

nextStart.description: Offset for the next page; absent on the final or past-end page.

notice.description: Advisory note (empty results, predicted-search caveats, truncation, facet dimensions whose buckets cover materially less than totalCount). Carries every applicable advisory in one string.

queryLength.description: Length in residues of the query sequence that every hit's queryStart and queryEnd index into (sequence searches whose hits carry an alignment).

start.description: Zero-based offset of the returned page.

title: protein-mcp-server: search structures
